findings.title: Making `.small-action` a flex container disables its right-aligned button
findings.body: The direct `button` child still relies on `float: right` (line 309) to be placed at the right edge. Floats on flex items are ignored, so after this change the button participates in the flex flow immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead of being right-aligned. Small-action controls will therefore move beside the description (and may overflow or be poorly positioned for long descriptions) rather than retaining their existing placement.
